answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the terrace queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The opal index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 857 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the vault. A 462 account operation therefore ties up 29 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
